headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Just Gave Investors Something To Think About
headlines.summary: Datadog earnings and guidance set the stage Datadog (DDOG) stock is in focus after the company reported third quarter 2026 results, alongside fresh guidance that outlines expected revenue between US$1.19b and US$1.20b for the next quarter. The earnings release and guidance arrive after a sharp reset in sentiment. Datadog’s share price has fallen about 25% over the past month even though the year to date share price return is up 37.67%. headlines.title: Rocket Companies Appoints Datadog COO Adam Blitzer to Board of Directors
headlines.summary: Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), the Detroit-based homeownership platform, today announced the appointment of Adam Blitzer, Chief Operating Officer of Datadog, as an independent director to its Board of Directors.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
